packages.label: מַלְכוּת וּשְׁכִינָה
packages.reason: All seven nodes are identified in the teaching as parallel aspects of a single divine reality: the Shekhinah/Malkhut dimension of holiness. The teaching explicitly states that דיבור (holy speech) is בחינת מלכות, שכינה is בחינת מלכות, רוח הקדש is בחינת מלכות, רוחו של משיח is בחינות רוח הקדש and שכינה, and תחיה is בחינות יחוד and רוח הקדש. They are not cause-and-effect relationships — they are multiple names and faces of the same underlying divine presence. The editorial note at the end of the Torah (§21) confirms this explicitly: 'הדבור דקדושה הוא בחינות השכינה, והוא בחינות רוחו של משיח בחינות רוח הקדש, בחינות תחיה, בחינות יחוד קדשא בריך הוא ושכינתה.'

merge_notes.merged_component: Component B — {מוציא ומכניס הרוח, 'החיות רצוא ושוב'}
merge_notes.merge_reason: Rejected — kept separate. Although the text says 'מוציא ומכניס הרוח... וזהו בחינת רוח הקדש,' this connection reads as an eitza bridge (the mechanism BY WHICH one draws holy spirit) rather than a shared essential nature. The physical breath-motion and the cosmic ratzoh-vashov motion share the same structural nature as each other (both are the back-and-forth rhythm of life-force), but their connection to the מלכות cluster in the text is presented as the *means* of attaining רוח הקדש, not as an equation of essential nature. They therefore remain a separate package describing the mechanism/medium of cosmic vital motion.

packages.label: מוֹצִיא וּמַכְנִיס הָרוּחַ
packages.reason: The two nodes share the same structural nature: both describe the reciprocal, oscillating motion of vital force — one on the physical level (inhaling and exhaling), the other on the cosmic level (the divine creatures' ratzoh vashov). They are two expressions of the same underlying rhythm. This is a neutral physical/cosmic description that serves as the medium through which holy spirit flows. The proof text reads: 'מוציא ומכניס הרוח, וזהו בחינת החיות רצוא ושוב.' The concept is neutral — the same breath-motion can carry holy spirit (when attached to Malkhut) or impure spirit (when attached to the old foolish king), so it cannot be assigned to the good domain on its own.

packages.label: מְקוֹמוֹת הַמְטֻנָּפִים
packages.reason: Both nodes are explicitly identified as aspects of the same spiritual domain: the realm of degradation and impurity — the 'place' of galut haShekhinah. 'מקומות הנמוכים, שהם בחינות מקומות המטנפים' — low spiritual places ARE the defiled places. These represent the evil/exile dimension: the domain of tumah and spiritual downfall where the Shekhinah must accompany Israel even in its fallen state. They stand as the dark counterpart to the holy מלכות/שכינה cluster. The teaching frames these places as precisely what the Shekhinah must endure in galut: 'השוכן אתם בתוך טומאותם.'

packages.label: תּוֹרָה וְכַנְפֵי רֵאָה
packages.label_en: Torah and the Wings of the Lung
packages.reason: The two nodes share the essential nature of a protective, moderating, life-sustaining force. The lung-wings ARE Torah: 'כנפי ראה הוא בחינות התורה.' Both are the cooling/protecting presence that prevents the human heart from burning up — whether from excessive holy fire or from the fire of worldly desire. The Zohar source cited in the text (Tikkune Zohar 13; Zohar Pinchas) further identifies ריאה with מים and מים with תורה, forming a chain of bechina identities. Torah is the divine life-principle that moderates and sustains; the lung-wings are its physical analog.
